svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Plasma EUV
svg.desc: Two lanes to a top-hat pupil of sigma 0.9: a CO2 laser hits 25 to 30 micrometre Sn droplets, the plasma emits into 2 pi sr and a collector focuses it at the intermediate focus; a capacitor bank pinches Xe or Sn, grazing shells collect it and an etendue cut sets the IF power.
svg.text: how the light is made → the illuminator pupil

g.text: Laser-produced plasma (LPP) · Sn 13.5 nm · Gd 6.7 / Tb 6.5 nm beyond-EUV
Discharge-produced plasma (DPP / LDP) · Xe or Sn · 13.5 nm

svg.text: Powers are stated at the intermediate focus; η₂π→IF is a lumped LPP factor, the DPP collector and étendue factors are assumptions.
